_description: The JSON object Intern A's recommender returns. Intern B's LLM layer consumes this.
_owner: Agreed by Intern A & Intern B at end of Week 1 (SYNC 1)

field_definitions.dish_name: string   — canonical dish name from the dataset
field_definitions.cuisine: string   — always 'Indian' for now; expand later if dataset grows
field_definitions.region: string|null — e.g. North, South, East, West, North East. null if unknown
field_definitions.state: string|null — e.g. Punjab, West Bengal. null if unknown
field_definitions.meal_type: string   — one of: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack
field_definitions.flavor_profile: string|null — one of: sweet | spicy | savory | bitter | sour. null if unknown
field_definitions.ingredients_required: string[] — all normalised ingredients the dish needs
field_definitions.ingredients_available: string[] — subset the user said they have (matched after normalisation)
field_definitions.missing_ingredients: string[] — ingredients_required minus ingredients_available. Empty [] if fully covered
field_definitions.coverage_score: float 0.0–1.0 — len(available) / len(required). Intern B: flag to user if < 0.4
field_definitions.dietary_tags: string[] — e.g. ['vegetarian', 'spicy']. Intern B uses this for recipe framing
field_definitions.user_type: string   — one of: bachelor | student | family | health-focused
field_definitions.prep_time_mins: int      — total prep time in minutes

rules.missing_ingredients: Always present, never omitted. Empty array [] when nothing is missing — not null.
rules.coverage_score: If coverage_score < 0.4, Intern B's LLM must ask the user about missing_ingredients before generating the recipe.
rules.nulls: Only region and state may be null. All other fields must always be present.
rules.user_type: Intern B collects this from the user at session start and passes it in the request to Intern A.
